name: rcore_app
description: Frappe compose template for the tenant ERP docker (composes an app named rcore)
_comment: The ERP docker where tenants start (Ray 2026-10-24): rcore.json's full module list plus erp and hrms. Supersedes rcore.json, which stays as a deprecated record. Named 'rcore_app' like every tenant template, so the composer derives an app named 'rcore' (the name maps to the app by dropping the '_app' suffix: control_app -> control, rcore_app -> rcore). erp, hrms, gateways and wallet carry rokctapp.json's pay pin exactly, because the composer clones one ref per repo and every pay module must share it.

modules.name: base
modules._comment: Added during composer schema migration: corporate/polaris/frappe's Loan and LoanTransfer doctypes have Link fields with options="Branch", and Branch is only defined in this module (moved on disk to core/base/frappe from the retired core/core). Without composing it, polaris's doctype links would fail to resolve. manifest.json's own 'name' and its 137 hardcoded '{app_name}.core....' hook path segments were rewritten to 'base' in the same commit as this rename, so the module 'name' here and the manifest's identity now agree.

modules.name: lms
modules._comment: Supacharge's home SDK (LMS domain: lessons, schedule, partner links). Moved here from paas/composer.json (2026-07-24) so lms is always present for every tenant via rcore, same as brain, gated by a subscription flag instead of by paas-plan eligibility — a tenant on a non-paas plan no longer loses lms access.

modules.name: replay
modules._comment: Supacharge's session-replay SDK (Replay Session schedule + decision #8 release-asset pipeline: fetch/cache/serve, warm + evict). Composed beside lms, which its serving gates resolve into.

modules.name: gateways
modules._comment: Same pay pin as erp/hrms/wallet below: the composer clones one ref per repo, so every pay module entry must share it. Replaces the retired 'pay' entry (../pay/payments/frappe no longer carries a frappe module or manifest.json): pay's payments/frappe content moved into the gateways and wallet modules, so this template mirrors rcore.json's wallet+gateways pair.

modules.name: builder
modules._comment: Replaces the 'dev' entry (../corporate/dev/frappe): corporate/builder/frappe is the same Flutter build pipeline composed under its contract paths ({app_name}.builder.tasks._generate_flutter_app, {app_name}/builder/source_code). The two entries cannot coexist - both ship the flutter_app_configuration / flutter_build_settings doctypes and the composer hard-fails on duplicate DocTypes.

modules.name: crm
modules._comment: Core CRM slice (leads, deals, contacts, organizations, notes, tasks, call logs, statuses) ported from Frappenize/crm (frappe/crm fork) into the productivity SDK. Composing this module replaces installing the standalone frappe/crm app — a site must NOT have frappe/crm installed alongside rcore, since the doctype names (CRM Lead, CRM Deal, ...) are intentionally identical and would double-define. Existing sites need one 'bench execute rcore.patches.crm_seed_defaults.execute' to seed default statuses.

modules.name: erp
modules._comment: ERPNext v16 fork flattened into one composed module (fork of frappe/erpnext via Frappenize/erpnext@rokct-hotfix). Upstream crm/projects/support modules are excluded and resolve to the productivity repo's SDK modules; the five fleet-colliding doctypes (Branch, Brand, Delivery Settings, Subscription, Subscription Settings + dependents) are excluded per pay#35's collision review, so erp composes beside base/subscriptions/products/delivery. A site composed with this module must NOT also have upstream erpnext installed. Pinned at the pay head carrying the fleet-collision exclusion; strict-compose verified at this SHA.

modules.name: hrms
modules._comment: Frappe HR fork (via Frappenize/hrms@rokct-hotfix). Composes ONLY alongside the erp module above — the Employee master and accounting doctypes live in erp, and every upstream erpnext reference resolves to {app_name}.erp. Never add hrms to a template without erp. Same pay pin as erp.
